name: Aka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aka village emblem in yellow: a winged ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Aka, a village in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1984.

features.role: Aka village emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised character
